rationale: Generic soft-tissue liposarcoma variant with no literature-based restriction to a proper subset of its skin/soft-tissue/penis ceiling.

Generic biphasic carcinosarcoma descriptor; no literature restriction to a proper subset of the ceiling.
Generic vascular sarcoma descriptor occurring across skin and soft tissue; not restricted to a proper subset.

rationale: A clinical MF variant defined by pigmentary change, not anatomic site; occurs across the C44 skin ceiling.

term: Primary cutaneous acral CD8 positive T-cell lymphoma
rationale: This indolent entity favors acral sites (notably the ear), but the C44 skin ceiling has no acral-specific subdivision and mapping acral distribution to a discrete C-code subset is not supported by a clear source; restriction cannot be verified.

term: Primary cutaneous acral CD8-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
rationale: Acral (ear-predominant) indolent lymphoproliferative disorder, but the skin ceiling lacks an acral-specific C-code subdivision, so a proper subset cannot be reliably delineated.

term: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, unspecified

rationale: Primary cutaneous ALCL occurs across the skin ceiling; not anatomically restricted below it.

term: Primary mucosal CD30 positive large T-cell lymphoma
